name: cerebro
description: Cerebro — self-hosted management dashboard with pluggable connectors

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cerebro/shared && npm run build --workspace @cerebro/web && npm run build --workspace @cerebro/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @cerebro/server" "npm run dev --workspace @cerebro/web"
